subgoals.goal_text: Heal the party at the Pewter City Pokemon Center before heading to Mt. Moon.
Travel from Pewter City to Route 3.
Enter the entrance of Mt. Moon from Route 4.
Navigate through the first floor of Mt. Moon and find the stairs leading down to the basement.
Navigate through the first basement level to reach the second basement level.
Navigate through the second basement level to find the exit leading out of the mountain.
